    INDUSTRY AND POSITION                                            行業及定位
    With an ageing population and urbanization, the demand for       中國健康產業潛力巨大，老齡化、城鎮化的
    healthcare services is on the increase which provides great      加速帶來大眾對健康服務需求的持續增長。
    opportunities for the healthcare industry. As the                在政府辦醫療機構承擔最基本醫療服務供給
    Government’s responsibility is to provide basic medical          職能的前提下，社會辦醫療機構潛力仍有待
    services, the potential for private services have yet to be      繼續挖掘。去年國家衛生健康委員會和國家
    explored. With the establishment of National Health              醫保局成立後，一系列醫療行業改革政策陸
    Commission (國家衛生健康委員會) and National Health Care                  續推出：強基層、家庭醫生簽約服務、分級
    Security Administration (國家醫保局), a series of reform              診療體系建設、「互聯網+醫療」將是政府醫
    policies have been announced focusing on the enhancement         改政策的主要方向。華潤醫療從事的大健康
    of primary healthcare services, contract family doctors          產業是華潤集團重點培育的業務，我們將繼
    services, triage system and “Internet + Medical” services. It    續為健康中國賦力。
    also encourages social capital to participate in the
    development of private medical services. The development
    of healthcare services is a major policy and a focus direction
    of China Resources Group and we will work with the Group
    to build a Healthy China.

    OUTLOOK                                                          發展展望
    As the listed platform of CR Group’s medical services, the 作 為 華 潤 集 團 旗 下 的 醫 療 服 務 板 塊 上 市 平
    Group, while continuing to seek business expansion in an 台，本集團將在獲取和運營國企醫院以有序
    orderly manner by way of acquiring and operating state- 推進規模擴張的同時，充分整合內部資源並
    owned hospitals, will fully integrate the internal resources of 創新合作模式，積極佈局和深耕全國重點區
    ours and CR Group’s and innovate upon new approaches to 域營利性醫院項目，探索培育專科連鎖醫療
    cooperation, proactively plan for and work on projects of for- 服務體系，構建優質的醫療產業集群，實現

    opportunities of establishing a chain of specialist medical

     管理層討論與分析

     Business Review                                                  業務回顧
     During the Reporting Period, following implementation of the     報 告 期 內，隨 著 國 務 院 機 構 改 革 方 案 的 落
     State Council’s plan of institutional reform, a number of        地，醫療行業改革政策頻出，醫改進入第三
     reform policies in respect of the medical industry were          階段，更加關注資源配置效率和醫療服務品
     issued and the medical industry reform has entered the third     質，力求改變激勵機制，引入市場和競爭機
     stage. The third stage reform focuses on the efficiency of       制，踐行價值醫療理念。全面推進醫療、醫
     resources allocation and quality of medical services, seeks to   保、醫藥「三醫聯動」工作機制，建立分級診
     change the incentive mechanism, introduce a market-              療 制 度，確 定 發 展「互 聯 網+醫 療 健 康」措
     oriented and competition-based mechanism, with a view to         施，緩 解 看 病 就 醫 難 題、提 升 人 民 健 康 水
     practicing a more value-based concept of medical and             準，不斷提高我國醫療保障水準成為醫改第
     healthcare services. China is in full gear in fostering Joint    三階段的工作重點。
     Reformation for Public Health Services, Medical Insurance
     and Medical Production Circulation (“三醫聯動”), establish
     multi-diagnosis system, determine principal policies of
     “Internet + Medical/Healthcare”, and reduce people’s

  interpretations when it becomes effective.                        相關詮釋。

  IFRS 16 distinguishes lease and service contracts on              國際財務報告準則第16號基於確定資
  the basis of whether an identified asset is controlled            產是否由客戶控制區分租賃及服務合
  by a customer. In addition, IFRS 16 requires sales and            同。此外，國際財務報告準則第16號規
  leaseback transactions to be determined based on the              定，銷售及回租交易將根據國際財務報
  requirements of IFRS 15 as to whether the transfer of             告準則第15號的規定釐定有關資產的
  the relevant asset should be accounted as a sale. IFRS            轉讓是否應作為銷售入賬。國際財務報
  16 also includes requirements relating to subleases               告準則第16號亦包括有關分租及租賃
  and lease modifications.                                          修訂的規定。

  Distinctions of operating leases and finance leases are           經營租賃及融資租賃的區別已從承租人
  removed for lessee accounting, and is replaced by a               會計刪除，由承租人就所有租賃確認使
  model where a right-of-use asset and a corresponding              用權資產及相應負債的模式取代，短期
  liability have to be recognised for all leases by lessees,        租賃及低價值資產租賃除外。
  except for short-term leases and leases of low value
  assets.

  The right-of-use asset is initially measured at cost and          使用權資產最初按成本計量，隨後按成
  subsequently measured at cost (subject to certain                 本（存在特定例外情況）減累計折舊及
  exceptions) less accumulated depreciation and                     減值虧損計量，就租賃負債的任何重新
  impairment losses, adjusted for any remeasurement of              計量作出調整。租賃負債最初按當日未
  the lease liability. The lease liability is initially             支付之租賃款現值計量。隨後，租賃負
  measured at the present value of the lease payments               債就利息及租賃款及租賃修改的影響作

  liability is adjusted for interest and lease payments, as         前將先前預付租賃款呈列為與自用之租
  well as the impact of lease modifications, amongst                賃土地有關的投資現金流，其他經營租
  others. For the classification of cash flows, the Group           賃付款呈列為經營現金流。於應用國際
  currently presents upfront prepaid lease payments as              財 務 報 告 準 則 第16號 後，與 租 賃 負 債
  investing cash flows in relation to leasehold lands for           有關的租賃付款將由本集團分配至本金
  owned use while other operating lease payments are                及利息部分，分別呈列為融資現金流，

      3. SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES                                3. 主要會計政策
           The consolidated financial statements have been                   綜合財務報表按IASB發佈的國際財務
           prepared in accordance with IFRSs issued by the IASB.             報告準則編製。此外，綜合財務報表包
           In addition, the consolidated financial statements                括聯交所證券上市規則以及香港公司條
           include applicable disclosures required by the Rules              例規定之適用披露。
           Governing the Listing of Securities on the Stock
           Exchange and by the Hong Kong Companies
           Ordinance.

           The consolidated financial statements have been                   如下文所載會計政策闡釋，除若干金融
           prepared on the historical cost basis except for certain          工具於各報告期末按公允價值計量外，
           financial instruments that are measured at fair values at         綜合財務報表按歷史成本法編製。
           the end of each reporting period, as explained in the
           accounting policies set out below.

           Historical cost is generally based on the fair value of           歷史成本一般以交換貨品及服務時給予
           the consideration given in exchange for goods and                 代價的公允價值為基準。
           services.

           Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an         公允價值乃於計量日在市場參與者之間
           asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly               在有序交易中出售資產所收取或轉讓負
           transaction between market participants at the                    債所付出的價格，而不論該價格為可直
           measurement date, regardless of whether that price is             接觀察或使用另一估值技術估計。於估
           directly observable or estimated using another valuation          計資產或負債的公允價值時，本集團會
           technique. In estimating the fair value of an asset or a          考慮市場參與者於計量日對資產或負債
           liability, the Group takes into account the                       定價時所考慮的資產或負債的特徵。於
           characteristics of the asset or liability if market               該等綜合財務報表中作計量及╱或披露
           participants would take those characteristics into                之用的公允價值乃按此基準釐定，惟屬

                  the exposure at default. The assessment of the                     約可能性及違約虧損率的評估乃
                  probability of default and loss given default is                   按照歷史數據進行，並就前瞻性

                  looking information. Estimation of ECL reflects an                 估計反映以發生的相關違約風險
                  unbiased and probability-weighted amount that is                   作為加權數值而確定的無偏概率
                  determined with the respective risks of default                    加權金額。
                  occurring as the weights.

                  in accordance with the contract and the cash                       約現金流量與本集團預期將收取

                  discounted at the effective interest rate                          按於初步確認時釐定的實際利率
                  determined at initial recognition.                                 折現。

      38. SHARE-BASED PAYMENT                                           38. 以股份付款之交易
          TRANSACTIONS
           The Scheme                                                        該計劃
           On 7 July 2014, the Company adopted the Scheme as                 於2014年7月7日，本 公 司 該 計 劃，作
           a means to recognise the contribution of and provide              為 表 彰 本 集 團 主 要 管 理 人 員（包 括 董
           incentives for the key management personnel including             事、高 級 管 理 層、受 聘 專 家 及 核 心 僱

                                                                              （「獲選參與者））所作貢獻及為彼等
           core employees of the Group (the “Selected                        提供激勵的方式。該計劃將自2014年7
           Participants”). The Scheme shall be valid and effective           月7日（「採納日期」）起10年內有效及生
           for a period of 10 years commencing on 7 July 2014                效。根據該計劃授出的股份將由本公司
           (the “Adoption Date”). The shares to be awarded under             經由受託人從本集團繳入的現金中從公
           the Scheme will be acquired by the Company through                開 市 場 購 入（「獎 勵 股 份」），並 由 信 託
           the trustee from the open market out of cash                      人為獲選參與者持有，直至有關股份根
           contributed by the Group (the “Award Shares”) and be              據該計劃之規定歸屬為止。
           held in trustee for the Selected Participants until such
           shares are vested in accordance with the provisions of
           the Scheme.

           In order to provide more flexibility in the administration        董事會為了就管理及執行計劃提供更高
           and implementation of the Scheme, the Board resolved              靈活性，董事會於2015年5月25日議決
           on 25 May 2015 to make amendments to the terms of                 修訂計劃之條款及計劃規則，自採納日
           the Scheme and the Scheme Rules, having                           期起追溯生效，以示明董事會可不時絕
           retrospective effect from the Adoption Date, to the               對酌情決定向獲選參與者授出獎勵股份
           effect that the Board may, from time to time, in its              時，相關獲選參與者是否應付每股獎勵
           absolute discretion, determine if the Award Shares                股 份 價 格（「授 出 價 格」），須 由 董 事 會
           shall be granted to a Selected Participant with or                知會各獲選參與者。於釐定獲選參與者
           without payment of a price per Award Share payable                是否須就獎勵股份支付授出價及授出價
           by the Selected Participant (the “Grant Price”) which             以 及 其 金 額（視 乎 情 況 而 定）時，董 事
